g.text: FEATURED · IN DAILY USE SINCE MAR 2026
The ERP my family's pallet business runs on.
Purchases, sales, payments and cheques in one
fast app for PC and phone.
Bills, invoices and quotations with VAT and PO
Party ledgers in English and Urdu
Cheque register with reminders on the phone
A small queue holds every save.
A GitHub Action sends Web Push.
